name: PR overview: the Prepare overview button is on the Overview tab
description:
Spec 06 AC-15. From PR #482 the default Overview tab renders the Prepare overview header action. The seeded acme/payments-api has no clone (clonePath is null in the seed), so readiness plans a clone and the button reads 'Prepare overview' once loaded. The button is NOT clicked: the seeded repo does not exist on GitHub, so a clone would only fail.

Read-only seeded data (no model call).
